title: WebSocket: Make the max unmasked payload length configurable
description:
## Change Description

Change the max unmasked payload length from macro to a configurable
preference. 

Add an expert item if the payload exceeds the max unmasked payload length.

## Example

There is a test WebSocket subprotocol named RTWP (Resource Transfer WebSocket Protocol) whose format is:

```
     +--------------------------------------+
     |   2 bytes 1st resource name size     |
     +--------------------------------------+
     |          1st Resource name           |
     +--------------------------------------+
     |       4 bytes binary data size       |
     +--------------------------------------+
     |          1st resource data           |
     |               ......                 |
     +======================================+
     |   2 bytes 2nd resource name size     |
     +--------------------------------------+
     |         2nd Resource name            |
     +--------------------------------------+
     |       4 bytes binary data size       |
     +--------------------------------------+
     |          2nd resource data           |
     |               ......                 |
     +======================================+
     |                 .                    |
                       .
                       .
```

You can get the Lua code of the RTWP dissector at [resource_transfer_websocket_protocol.lua](/uploads/77ef8f10c3af5e202dbbb658df0711d5/resource_transfer_websocket_protocol.lua).

A sample capture about RTWP is here 
[resource_transfer_websocket_protocol.pcapng](/uploads/cc9e9bc507d5bcd1616be14c4f46bf5e/resource_transfer_websocket_protocol.pcapng)

With previous version of Wireshark, only parts of resources are parsed because the default `max unmasked payload length` (which is a macro of 1024*256 number) is unable to be modified:

![old_version_default_limit_unable_modified](/uploads/7025bee34f08141a3f90dcd2f3fef938/old_version_default_limit_unable_modified.png)

After applying this change, an expert item will be added in the tree to let user know what causes the dissecting failure:
 
![new_version_an_expert_item_is_added](/uploads/87c1cc5b631c6d2ece77531f5aacfaf0/new_version_an_expert_item_is_added.png)

And user can modify the value of `max unmasked payload length` preference to make all resources being parsed correctly:

![new_version_modify_max_unmasked_length](/uploads/d17866db9edb1c772098372c6a1b8b75/new_version_modify_max_unmasked_length.png)
